name: GlobalDev Mega Product Importer for WooCommerce
author: Globaldev

sections.description:
GlobalDev Mega Product Importer for WooCommerce supports simple and variable products, variations, categories, category hierarchy, tags, product brands, attributes, prices, stock, images, variation images, descriptions, dimensions, shipping classes, downloads, upsells, cross-sells, grouped-product relationships, and REST-exposed custom metadata.

Authenticated REST mode is recommended for full-fidelity migrations. Public Store API mode can import only fields exposed publicly by the source store.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Open WooCommerce > GlobalDev Mega Product Importer for WooCommerce.
  3. Enter the source WooCommerce URL or upload a CSV.
  4. Scan and import products individually or in bulk.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Align the plugin text domain with the WordPress.org assigned slug.
  • Update the WordPress.org contributor username to globaldevitus.

1.0.2

  • Mark products that are already imported when scanning a source URL.
  • Show the local WooCommerce product ID/edit link and distinguish Import versus Update actions.
  • Respect Skip existing products in the scan table by disabling already-imported rows.
  • Make Load next page replace the current page instead of appending products from previous pages.

1.0.1

  • Keep third-party WordPress admin notices outside the styled importer header.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
